issues.current_text: o Irã recusou a segunda rodada de negociações no Paquistão

issues.suggestion: This exact fact — Iran refusing the second round — already ran on April 22. On April 23 it's presented as if new. Either cut it or frame it as continuity: 'O Irã manteve a recusa à segunda rodada de negociações' or just drop the clause entirely since the reader already knows.

issues.current_text: A SK Hynix, líder em memórias para IA, fechou o primeiro trimestre com receita recorde de US$38,9 bilhões
issues.previous_text: A SK Hynix começou a construir a P&T7, fábrica de empacotamento avançado [...] de US$12,85 bilhões [...] A empresa hoje responde por 61% do mercado global de memória de alta performance para IA.
issues.suggestion: SK Hynix has been the lead or near-lead story for 4 consecutive editions (Apr 20: mass production for Nvidia; Apr 22: $12.85B factory + 61% market share; Apr 23: earnings record). The earnings are genuinely new, but the reader has been saturated with SK Hynix dominance. Consider trimming the 'líder em memórias para IA' descriptor — the reader knows by now — and don't re-explain HBM chips ('chips empilhados que alimentam aceleradores de IA') since that was covered recently.

issues.current_text: Intel [...] no Terafab, complexo de fabricação de chips de IA em Austin
issues.previous_text: A Intel acelerou pedidos de equipamentos para suas fábricas em mais de 50% [...] preparando o terreno para o processo de fabricação 14A [...] Nvidia, Apple, Google e AMD deram feedback positivo e devem assinar contratos de fabricação no outono americano.
issues.suggestion: Intel 14A was covered on April 20 (equipment orders up 50%, major clients expected). The Tesla angle is new, but the reader already has context on 14A. A brief nod to continuity would help: 'A Tesla será a primeira grande cliente confirmada do 14A da Intel — processo que já atraiu interesse de Nvidia e Apple.'

issues.previous_text: Na direção oposta, a Samsung adiou indefinidamente a produção da HBM5E
issues.suggestion: Identical transitional phrase in consecutive editions. Replace with a different pivot: 'Já a Microsoft...', 'Do lado dos investimentos,...', or restructure the paragraph to avoid needing a contrast connector.

issues.current_text: fabricante holandesa de equipamentos para produção de chips
issues.previous_text: fabricante holandesa de equipamentos para produção de semicondutores
issues.suggestion: Nearly identical descriptor used for ASML (Apr 23) and ASM International (Apr 22) — two different Dutch companies described with the same appositive. The reader may confuse them. For ASML, try: 'a ASML, que fabrica as máquinas de litografia usadas por todas as grandes fundições' — this distinguishes from ASM and explains the relevance better.

issues.current_text: Separadamente, Elon Musk anunciou [...] Separadamente, a empresa abriu acesso gratuito
issues.previous_text: Separadamente, Trump disse à CNBC que um acordo para a Anthropic voltar a contratar com o Departamento de Defesa 'é possível'
issues.suggestion: 'Separadamente' appears twice in the April 23 draft and once in April 21. Two uses in one edition is too many. Keep one (the OpenAI section, where it marks a genuine topic shift within the same company). For the Tesla/Intel item, restructure: fold it into the Fabricação paragraph as a closing sentence without a transition word, or open with 'Em outra frente,...'.

issues.current_text: O petróleo Brent ultrapassou brevemente US$100 por barril, alta de 35% em relação aos níveis anteriores à guerra
issues.previous_text: o petróleo Brent, referência internacional, subiu 5,3%, a US$95,62 o barril (Apr 20); combustíveis saltando 8,7% em um mês (Apr 22)
issues.suggestion: Oil price as Iran-escalation barometer has run in 3 of the last 4 editions (Apr 20: $95.62; Apr 22: fuel inflation 8.7%; Apr 23: briefly $100). The $100 milestone is genuinely new and important — keep it — but acknowledge the trajectory instead of presenting it as a standalone fact: 'O Brent, que estava a US$95 no início da semana, ultrapassou brevemente US$100...' This rewards the returning reader.

issues.current_text: SK Hynix bate recorde com margem de 72%; Samsung enfrenta o maior protesto da história; três labs chineses agitam a IA aberta; Irã atira em navios no Ormuz.
issues.previous_text: SpaceX fecha acordo de até US$60bi pela Cursor; Mythos acha 271 falhas no Firefox 150; SK Hynix investe US$12,85bi em fábrica de memória para IA.
issues.suggestion: The subtitle structure — four punchy clauses separated by semicolons — is identical across all editions. Consider varying the format occasionally: a single declarative sentence, a question, or two longer clauses instead of four short ones. The pattern is becoming a tic.

issues.current_text: modelo denso de código aberto com 27 bilhões de parâmetros que supera o próprio Qwen3.5-397B — 15 vezes maior — em testes de programação autônoma, pontuando 77,2% no SWE-bench Verified
issues.previous_text: Kimi K2.6, modelo de código aberto com 1 trilhão de parâmetros que superou o Opus 4.6 da Anthropic e o GPT-5.4 da OpenAI no principal teste de programação autônoma, por um décimo do preço
issues.suggestion: Same narrative frame two days apart: 'open-source Chinese model with X parameters beats bigger/pricier rivals on coding benchmarks'. Both use 'programação autônoma' and the 'David vs Goliath' angle. Reframe: lead with what's structurally different about Qwen3.6 (dense model beating its own MoE sibling — an architecture story) rather than 'yet another Chinese model tops a benchmark'.

summary: Moderate repetition. Iran/negotiations fact repeated verbatim from Apr 22; SK Hynix saturating 4 straight editions; 'Na direção oposta' and 'Separadamente' reused as crutch transitions; Chinese-model-beats-benchmark framing echoes Apr 21. Oil-price-as-escalation-meter needs arc awareness. Subtitle structure is formulaic across all editions.
